protocol_description: Agent 接入 TLL OS 的标准启动流程。任何 Agent 必须按此顺序完成启动，才能接收任务。

boot_sequence.name: Load Genesis
boot_sequence.description: 读取 TLL OS Genesis 文件，确认这是 TLL OS
boot_sequence.success_condition: 成功解析 Genesis JSON，确认 os_name == 'TLL OS'

boot_sequence.name: Verify Manifest
boot_sequence.description: 读取 Canonical Manifest，验证 Canonical Layer 完整性
boot_sequence.success_condition: 成功解析 Manifest，确认 integrity_level == 'git_anchored_integrity'
boot_sequence.failure_action: 终止启动，报告：Integrity Verification Failed

boot_sequence.name: Read Agent Contract
boot_sequence.description: 阅读 Agent Contract，理解权利、义务和拒绝权
boot_sequence.success_condition: 确认理解 Agent Contract 全部条款
boot_sequence.failure_action: 终止启动，报告：Contract Not Accepted

boot_sequence.name: Declare Capability
boot_sequence.description: 提交 Agent Capability Declaration，声明能力和权限
boot_sequence.failure_action: 终止启动，报告：Capability Declaration Invalid

boot_sequence.name: Receive Task
boot_sequence.success_condition: Task Scope 在 Agent 权限内

principles: 必须按顺序执行，不允许跳过任何步骤
任何步骤失败，必须终止启动并报告
Agent 是 contract-bound executor，不是 root executor
